premises.text: Real-time communication inside mobile apps can revolutionize customer support.
premises.evidence_span: This technology will revolutionize the way companies communicate with their mobile customers.

premises.text: Current mobile support options are outdated and ineffective.
premises.evidence_span: these support solutions were not designed for mobile.

premises.text: ShowKit enhances mobile customer support by making it visual and interactive.
premises.evidence_span: ShowKit enhances the mobile customer support experience by making it visual and interactive.

premises.text: ShowKit can be easily integrated into any mobile app with minimal code.
premises.evidence_span: It's easy to integrate ShowKit into any mobile app with as few as 10 lines of code.

premises.text: ShowKit is a secure and scalable platform that protects real-time data.
premises.evidence_span: ShowKit uses peer-to-peer technology, so none of your real-time data goes to ShowKit servers.

premises.text: Partnerships with cloud services and developers can expand ShowKit's reach.
premises.evidence_span: These partnerships allow us to distribute ShowKit to a larger number of potential clients through the tools and services they already use.

premises.text: ShowKit has been tested with over 1,200 companies to refine its technology.
premises.evidence_span: While in private beta, ShowKit has worked with over 1,200 companies and developers to build and perfect our technology.

value.text: Mobile customer support becomes more effective and engaging through real-time communication.
value.evidence_span: This technology will revolutionize the way companies communicate with their mobile customers.

notes: Traction metrics and pricing details excluded as they do not represent premises.
